about: Getty Center (Richard Meier, 1997), Brentwood, Los Angeles: hilltop museum campus, Central Garden, Cactus Garden, and the Getty Center Tram down to the Lower Tram Station / parking off N Sepulveda Blvd at Getty Center Drive. bbox lat 34.0700-34.0900 lon -118.4830 to -118.4650 (north edge extended from 34.0830: the lower station is at lat ~34.0875). Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright (via Overpass API). Elevation: USGS 3DEP / NED 1/3 arc-second (~10 m, bare earth, public domain) via OpenTopoData (ned10m), sampled on a 15 m grid. Frame: x=(lon+118.474)*92213 m east, y=(lat-34.078)*110940 m north. Getty campus building heights are assumptions (OSM has none): see bh_note.
bh_note: Building heights h are metres above local ground. Residential houses around the hill carry LA County height tags (used as-is). Getty campus buildings have no height/levels in OSM, so h is ASSUMED (flag ha=1): North/East/South/West Pavilions 13 m (two tall skylit gallery storeys above the plaza), Exhibitions Pavilion 11 m, Museum Entrance Hall 16 m (rotunda drum), Research Institute / Conservation Institute / Foundation 13 m, Auditorium 9 m, Family Room 4.5 m, other unnamed campus buildings 9 m, building=roof canopies 5 m top (mh = h-0.8). Lower tram station shelter (Arrival Area) 6 m. The main parking structure (P1-P7) is underground below the T1 plaza: k=parking_ug, h=1 (deck kerb only). Lower levels built into the hillside below plaza level are not modelled. Kinds: getty = campus building, getty_roof = campus canopy, plus house/commercial/worship/other off campus.

tram.note: p = [x, y, z_track] with z from the ned10m grid; on bridge=yes spans the deck is a straight grade between the abutment ground heights (min 1 m clearance) -- the real viaduct profile is not in OSM, so deck heights are approximate. zg = ground under each point. Line runs lower station -> upper station.
